title: Boolean circuit encoding
statement: A Boolean circuit encoding assigns binary strings to packed Boolean circuits and decodes every such string back to its circuit, with encoding followed by decoding recovering each circuit and every successfully decoded string being the canonical encoding of its decoded circuit. The length of each circuit's encoding is at least its size, where size is the number of input bits plus the number of gates.
hypotheses_covered: Encoding followed by decoding recovers each packed Boolean circuit
Every successfully decoded string is the encoding of its decoded circuit
Each encoded circuit's length is at least its size
